checks.details: Correct fixture passed, injected fault failed simulation as expected, repaired fixture passed.
Icarus 12 compilation without diagnostics; matching vvp passed 2355 checked rising edges.

limitations: Development verification is not official evaluation; official correctness is not established.
No synthesis, timing, or board verification performed, as required.
Initial state before synchronous reset is unconstrained by the prose; no initial-value assertion imposed. Payload is checked only when done is asserted.
Coincident waveform input changes are replayed using nonblocking assignments after edge sampling, consistent with all original timestamped outputs.

implementation.behavior: Three-state byte receiver accepts a first byte with bit 3 set, then two unconditional bytes. Completion is registered after third-byte sampling; next packet can begin at the following edge.
implementation.reset: Original active-high synchronous reset clears progress and done, leaving don't-care data unreset.
implementation.packing: Unsigned 8-bit first, second, third bytes concatenate into 24-bit output in original order.
implementation.static_review: Single sequential driver per register, nonblocking assignments, explicit enum state branches, no added ports or initialization, no extra packet latency.
